# T-1: Model requirement excerpts

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Represent target requirement prompt content as dedicated classes and update the requirement check prompt to consume excerpts instead of full spec text in the file-map path.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Requirement prompt content can be rendered for one or more target requirements without including unrelated spec sections.
- Prompt content includes each target requirement id, description, priority when present, and testable marker when explicitly false.

## Implementation Notes
Keep existing bulk prompt behavior available for the no-file-map path. Follow the project OOP rule for meaningful values.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests assert prompt content includes target requirements and excludes unrelated full spec text.
